chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn Ziyād, from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, who said:
I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام saying: The qāmah is the dhirāʿ.

key_terms.الذِّرَاعُ: the cubit; a unit of length used here to explain al-qāmah
key_terms.الْقَامَةُ: a measured unit mentioned in rulings for prayer times
key_terms.سَمِعْتُ: I heard directly, indicating direct transmission

ai.seo_question: What does al-qāmah mean in narrations about the time of ẓuhr and ʿaṣr?
ai.summary: This hadith defines the term al-qāmah as being equivalent to a dhirāʿ. In the context of the chapter, it relates to determining the beginning time of ẓuhr and ʿaṣr prayers according to a measured length.
